style_guide.isometric: 3D-ish isometric city/blocks: sectors as buildings, money flow between companies (e.g. how a bank makes money)
style_guide.paper-cut: layered paper cut-outs with depth shadows (our PCJ collage look, more layers): stories, company histories
style_guide.3d data chart: perspective 3D bars/lines rising with camera move: results, returns, compare stocks
style_guide.synthwave: neon grid, purple-pink sunset, glowing lines: crypto, hype, F&O, bubbles
style_guide.3d explainer: 3D objects (coin stacks, vault, piggy bank) with lighting and camera orbit: how SIP/FD/NPS works
style_guide.maths diagram: clean graph paper, equations writing themselves, curves: compounding, CAGR, rule of 72, EMI maths
style_guide.cartoon explainer (cloud family): realistic Cloud Family cast with multi-voice dialogue (kasitip engine)
style_guide.domino reveal: tiles/dominoes falling in a chain, each revealing a step: cause-and-effect (rate hike -> EMI -> spending -> stocks)
style_guide.glow atom: dark navy space, glowing orbits and labels like an atom diagram: portfolio = nucleus + orbiting assets, diversification
